anomalies.description: A white SUV collides with the rear driver's side of a gray sedan while both are in the intersection; the impact causes visible deformation and the gray sedan rotates slightly.

A white SUV collides with a dark sedan at an intersection; the sedan is struck on its left side/rear quarter, causing it to rotate and come to rest diagonally in the intersection with visible damage and debris on the road.
A silver sedan is stopped in the intersection with its rear left wheel detached and lying on the road surface, indicating a recent collision or mechanical failure.

A black SUV in the left lane collides with a yellow vehicle (possibly a construction barrier or another car), causing immediate visible damage and initiating fire.; The black SUV remains stationary post-collision, engulfed in flames and emitting thick smoke; this is a continuing consequence of the initial crash, not a separate event, but qualifies as an ongoing accident state with sustained hazard.

A sudden flash and burst of flame erupts from the rear of the black SUV immediately after impact, consistent with a fuel or component ignition—classified as an explosion due to rapid energy release.; A sudden bright orange flash and rapid fire eruption from the point of impact between the SUV and the yellow object, consistent with a fuel ignition or small explosion upon collision.; A sudden flash and rapid fire eruption from the rear of the black SUV at impact, consistent with a fuel or component explosion upon collision.
A black SUV collides with another vehicle and immediately erupts in flames, then rolls onto its side while still burning.
